matchDetail: Both engines returned identical 5 author IDs.

explanation.title: Direct Co-Authors (1 Hop)
explanation.graphNotes: Cypher navigates index-free relationship pointers: (Author)-[:WROTE]->(Paper)<-[:WROTE]-(Author). It directly walks outgoing and incoming pointer structures without scanning relational indices.
explanation.relationalNotes: Oracle SQL requires a self-join on the PAPER_AUTHOR associative table (pa1.PaperID = pa2.PaperID), filtering out self-authorship and joining the AUTHOR dimension table to resolve researcher names.
explanation.whyGraph: Graph query is concise and declarative because relationships are first-class entities. SQL requires an explicit self-join on the intersection table plus grouping and filtering.

oracle.query:
SELECT DISTINCT pa2.AuthorID AS id, a2.Name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT pa1.PaperID) AS shared_papers
FROM PAPER_AUTHOR pa1
JOIN PAPER_AUTHOR pa2 ON pa1.PaperID = pa2.PaperID
JOIN AUTHOR a2 ON pa2.AuthorID = a2.AuthorID
WHERE pa1.AuthorID = :authorId AND pa2.AuthorID <> :authorId
GROUP BY pa2.AuthorID, a2.Name
ORDER BY id ASC

neo4j.query:
MATCH (a:Author {authorId: $authorId})-[:WROTE]->(p:Paper)<-[:WROTE]-(co:Author)
WHERE co.authorId <> a.authorId
RETURN DISTINCT co.authorId AS id, co.name AS name, count(DISTINCT p) AS shared_papers
ORDER BY id ASC
